sample: Two synthetic system voices, 10 Chinese and 10 English short sentences. Client and server on one Mac, PCM in real time. Semantic classifications by Codex, not independent human evaluation.
measurement: Elapsed from sending typed input to receiving translated text. For audio, elapsed from the last voiced PCM packet sent to translation receipt at the listener client, including silence detection. Browser painting and physical devices excluded. A translation already requested for the same original can be served from cache.
